card.title: The brain's share of the oxygen

body.question: The human brain represents only 2% of the body weight. What percentage of total body oxygen consumption does it receive?
body.reveal: It receives 20% of total body oxygen consumption, along with 15% of the cardiac output and 25% of total body glucose utilization.

probes.question: What share of the body weight does the human brain represent?
The brain receives 25% of which of these?

image_brief.show: A human brain, anatomical photo or illustration

claims.claim: Brain represents only 2% of body weight (question, probe 1 answer 2%)
claims.quote: Although the human brain represents only 2% of the body weight

claims.claim: Brain receives 20% of total body oxygen consumption (answer 20, title) and 15% of cardiac output
claims.quote: it receives 15% of the cardiac output, 20% of total body oxygen consumption

claims.claim: Brain receives 25% of total body glucose utilization (reveal, probe 2 answer; oxygen 20% and cardiac output 15% make the distractors wrong)
